next_week_purchased_quantity.instruction: Predict the purchased quantity for this anonymous product in the next source week using its eight preceding weekly observations.
next_week_purchased_quantity.field_description: product_code is an anonymous source product identifier, without a product description. target_week_index is the requested zero-based source week (0-51), not a calendar date. prior_weekly_purchased_quantities contains eight nonnegative integer quantities, oldest to newest, for the eight immediately preceding weeks.
